name: halo
title: Halo
description: Atmospheric scattering based halo effect with dynamic camera rotation and sun light simulation.

usage.label: Astro
React
Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-blocks/halo-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-halo
  scale={1}
  offset-x={0}
  offset-y={0}
  rotation={0}
  rotation-speed={0.5}
  background-color="#17181A"
  camera-distance={3}
  sun-x={0}
  sun-y={0}
  sun-z={1}
  intensity={1}
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-blocks/halo-element.js"></script>

<motion-halo
  scale="1"
  offset-x="0"
  offset-y="0"
  rotation="0"
  rotation-speed="0.5"
  background-color="#17181A"
  camera-distance="3"
  sun-x="0"
  sun-y="0"
  sun-z="1"
  intensity="1"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: offset-x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the halo center.

props.name: offset-y
props.description: Vertical offset of the halo center.

props.name: rotation-speed
props.description: Auto-rotation speed of the camera around the halo.

props.name: camera-distance
props.description: Distance of the camera from the halo center.

props.name: sun-x
props.description: X component of the sun light direction vector.

props.name: sun-y
props.description: Y component of the sun light direction vector.

props.name: sun-z
props.description: Z component of the sun light direction vector (toward viewer).

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness and intensity of the atmospheric scattering.
